name: Rasterize-then-splat (RtS)
definition: A method for differentiable rendering of 3D surfaces that supports both explicit and implicit representations, provides derivatives at occlusion boundaries, and is fast and simple to implement. It samples the surface using non-differentiable rasterization, then applies differentiable, depth-aware point splatting to produce the final image.
summary: Rasterize-then-splat is a fast, hardware-independent differentiable rendering method that avoids costly mesh processing by rasterizing surfaces and splatting shaded colors, providing derivatives at occlusion boundaries.
